Loading RC Rally Jump...
from js import document, window, console import asyncio import random # Constants WIDTH = 800 HEIGHT = 600 PLAYER_WIDTH = 120 PLAYER_HEIGHT = 90 GRAVITY = 0.4 FLAP_ACCEL = -9 MAX_FALL_SPEED = 10 PIPE_SPEED = 3 VERSION = "1.15" TAP_ZONE_Y = HEIGHT // 2 # Game state canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas") ctx = canvas.getContext("2d") player_x = 100 player_y = HEIGHT - PLAYER_HEIGHT - 50 player_vel_y = 0 game_over = False pipe_x = WIDTH pipe_height = 200 ground_y = HEIGHT - 50 def draw_loading(): console.log("Drawing loading screen") ctx.fillStyle = "#323264" ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT) ctx.fillStyle = "#FFC107" ctx.font = "40px Arial" ctx.textAlign = "center" ctx.fillText(f"RC Rally Jump {VERSION}", WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 20) ctx.fillStyle = "white" ctx.font = "20px Arial" ctx.fillText("Tap Below to Start", WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20) def draw_scene(): # Clear canvas ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT) # Draw sky ctx.fillStyle = "#87CEEB" ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT) # Draw ground ctx.fillStyle = "#00FF00" ctx.fillRect(0, ground_y, WIDTH, HEIGHT - ground_y) # Draw player (RC car) ctx.fillStyle = "#FF0000" ctx.fillRect(player_x, player_y, PLAYER_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT) # Draw obstacles ctx.fillStyle = "#00C800" ctx.fillRect(pipe_x, 0, 50, pipe_height) ctx.fillRect(pipe_x, pipe_height + 200, 50, HEIGHT - pipe_height - 200) # Game over text if game_over: ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)" ctx.fillRect(WIDTH/2 - 250, HEIGHT/2 - 50, 500, 100) ctx.fillStyle = "white" ctx.font = "30px Arial" ctx.textAlign = "center" ctx.fillText("Game Over! Tap Below to Restart", WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2) def update_game(): global player_y, player_vel_y, pipe_x, game_over, pipe_height # Update player position player_vel_y += GRAVITY player_y += player_vel_y player_vel_y = min(player_vel_y, MAX_FALL_SPEED) # Check ground collision if player_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT > ground_y: player_y = ground_y - PLAYER_HEIGHT player_vel_y = 0 # Update pipe position pipe_x -= PIPE_SPEED # Reset pipe when off screen if pipe_x < -50: pipe_x = WIDTH pipe_height = 100 + random.randint(0, 200) # Check pipe collision if (player_x + PLAYER_WIDTH > pipe_x and player_x < pipe_x + 50 and (player_y < pipe_height or player_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT > pipe_height + 200)): game_over = True # Game loop async def game_loop(): global player_vel_y, game_over, pipe_x, player_y while True: if not game_over: update_game() draw_scene() await asyncio.sleep(0.016) # ~60 FPS # Handle clicks def handle_click(event): global player_vel_y, game_over, pipe_x, player_y if event.offsetY > TAP_ZONE_Y: if not game_over: player_vel_y = FLAP_ACCEL console.log("Player jumped") else: player_y = HEIGHT - PLAYER_HEIGHT - 50 player_vel_y = 0 pipe_x = WIDTH pipe_height = 200 game_over = False console.log("Game restarted") # Initialize game async def init_game(): loading_div = document.getElementById("loading") canvas.style.display = "block" # Show loading screen draw_loading() await asyncio.sleep(1) # Reduced loading time # Hide loading element and start game loading_div.style.display = "none" # Add click event listener canvas.addEventListener("click", handle_click) # Start game loop asyncio.create_task(game_loop()) # Start the game asyncio.create_task(init_game())
